window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged; the Colombian Navy operation was announced 3 November. No new SOUTHCOM strike announcements or federal press releases could be verified, so those beats add nothing today.

stories.headline: Operation Iron Scale: twelve charged and about 18 kg of cocaine seized in the Fort Wayne, Indiana area
stories.body: Indiana State Police executed warrants on Tuesday 3 November with local task forces plus ATF, DEA and FBI, and announced results on 6 November. Officers took nearly 18,000 grams of cocaine, over 500 grams of fentanyl, roughly 1 kg of suspected marijuana, 26 firearms and more than $240,000 in cash; the dozen defendants face conspiracy to deal charges and more arrests are possible.

stories.headline: Colombian Navy recovers 1.77 tonnes of cocaine in Cauca and Nariño, with no arrests
stories.body: Announced 3 November, two Pacific-region operations yielded 66 bundles: 1,175 kg on a tributary of the San Juan de Micay river in López de Micay, Cauca, and 590 kg abandoned on Amarales beach in La Tola, Nariño. Authorities tied the loads to the Jaime Martínez structure and structure 30 respectively and valued the total at over USD 81 million.

stories.headline: Police find 150 kg of cocaine at a stash house in Granada, Meta, allegedly tied to FARC dissidents
stories.body: Reported 7 November after an investigation begun in October, the property served as a collection point for cocaine made in Guaviare labs. Authorities link the network to the Jorge Suárez Briceño front and say the drug was meant for shipment to the United States via parcels; no arrests were reported.
